headline: ADIB raises $500M in AT1 sukuk issuance
summary: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank (ADIB) has raised $500 million through an Additional Tier 1 (AT1) sukuk issuance. The offering attracted over $1.5 billion in investor demand, allowing the bank to tighten pricing to 7%.
why: AT1 sukuk are Islamic financial instruments used by banks to strengthen their capital base.

impacts.name: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank
impacts.why: Successful capital raising strengthens the bank's balance sheet.
